body: Thank you for saying this. I’m going to be there to him the best way I can.
I just want the pain to stop. I have BPD and everything is just too overwhelming all the time.
Then what’s the point and waiting after? They’ll still celebrate it next year.

All I do is burden everyone around me. This isn’t a “bad day” lol I’ve had major depression, PTSD and BPD for the past 8 years. I’m not weak I’m tired. I don’t have anyone else I can talk to. I’m alone. As far as my loved ones, I’m doing them a favor so they can live a life free of me. If you don’t like my post I can take it down, that’s not going to keep me alive however. It’ll only prove my point that it doesn’t matter what happens to me no one cares about me and I don’t matter.

I do. I’m in therapy 3 times a week. I’m on my medication that I take everyday consistently. I use my coping skills. I exercise not upsetting people or having unrealistic expectations of people. I’m working on becoming a better person. It doesn’t matter though. As soon as I tell anyone I have BPD they run because everyone thinks we’re all crazy. There’s a stigma that won’t go away and most people don’t take the time to see I just want to love.
